fact: On 18 July 2025 the Personal Data Protection Office declared Google LLC in breach of section 19 of the Act and regulation 30 for transferring Ugandans' personal data abroad without showing safeguards, and ordered it to submit its transfer compliance framework within 30 days.
title: Ssekamwa Frank & 3 Others v Google LLC (Complaint No. 08/11/24/6683)
